rationale_tr: Küflü peynirin keskinliği turbanın dumanıyla buluşur (Stilton + Talisker 10, Stilton + Ardbeg Uigeadail).
rationale_en: Blue cheese tang meets peat smoke (Stilton + Talisker 10, Stilton + Ardbeg Uigeadail).

rationale_tr: Şerinin kuru meyvesi fındıksı, olgun peynirle oynar (Macallan 12 Double Cask + Gouda; GlenDronach 15 + olgun cheddar).
rationale_en: Sherry's dried fruit plays against nutty, mature cheese (Macallan 12 Double Cask + Gouda; GlenDronach 15 + vintage cheddar).

rationale_tr: Hafif ve kremamsı peynir vanilyalı, meyvemsi viskiyi tatlandırır; narin peynire ağır viski verilmez.
rationale_en: Light, creamy cheese makes a vanilla-led, fruity malt taste sweeter; delicate cheese needs a lighter spirit.

rationale_tr: Ballı ve baharatlı Speyside tarzı, olgun cheddar ile klasik (Glenlivet 12 + 3 yıllık cheddar).
rationale_en: Honeyed, spicy Speyside style is a classic with aged cheddar (Glenlivet 12 + 3-year cheddar).
